chunks: And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from some of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
He was asked about the Mudabbarah (female slave manumitted upon her master's death) when her master has sexual relations with her, so he said, 'Yes.'

key_terms.الْمُدَبَّرَةِ: A female slave whose manumission is contingent upon her master's death
key_terms.يَقَعُ عَلَيْهَا: He has sexual relations with her

ai.seo_question: Is a master allowed to have sexual relations with his Mudabbarah before her manumission?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the Mudabbarah retains the status of a concubine (Umm Walad) during the interim period between the master's declaration of future manumission and his actual death. This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence as it establishes that the master's sexual rights remain valid and that the child born from this union will be free, thereby ensuring the slave's eventual manumission upon the master's death. The confirmation of 'Nayam' (Yes) underscores the continuity of the master-slave contractual bond until the specified condition is met.
